claim: The AWS container decision guide says organizations might choose to build on managed container services to reduce their operational overhead, and that many customers want their applications to be able to run in, or move to, a different environment, so that they can preserve choice or run an application both on premises and in the cloud.

evidence.quote: Organizations might choose to build on managed container services to reduce their operational overhead.

Many customers want to ensure that their applications can run in—and be migrated or moved to—a different environment. It's important for them to be able to preserve choice, or run an application both on premises and in the cloud.
